job.title: Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d) - Jobbird.com

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java & Spring | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, database performance tuning, CI/CD pipelines, and agile delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer holding a valid German work permit and working knowledge of German (B1).

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud position at Jobster. With over 5 years of professional backend experience building and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical knowledge of SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring for catalog, pricing, and customer data management.

bullets.label: B2B E-Commerce Platforms
bullets.text: Developed and maintained core SAP Hybris modules including the Promotions Engine, FlexibleSearch queries, Cronjobs, Impex scripts, and Order Management (OMS).

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Tooling
bullets.text: Worked successfully within agile development teams, participating in sprint workflows and leveraging tools like Jira and Confluence for collaboration.

bullets.label: API & Integration Management
bullets.text: Exposed OCC REST Web Services and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize product catalogs.

cover_en.gap: While my professional background is rooted in backend development and SAP Commerce Cloud technical delivery rather than holding a formal Product Owner role, I bring a solid foundational understanding of digital projects and e-commerce platforms. I am very keen to expand my responsibilities and learn more about product strategy in this role.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I will be available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application further.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to Jobster because of its dynamic technological environment and focus on robust e-commerce architectures. Applying my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience here allows me to contribute directly to complex platform initiatives while collaborating with talented cross-functional teams.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to contribute to robust B2B platforms within a collaborative agile environment.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience in Java, Spring, and enterprise e-commerce platforms (Hybris 2105/2211). Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am eager to contribute to your team. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application materials for the Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud position at Jobster. With over 5 years of professional experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development, Java, and agile workflows, I am eager to contribute to your technical initiatives.

I hold a valid German residence and work permit, and I am available to start on 16 December 2026 following my notice period. My CV and cover letter provide further details on my background.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
